content: Hey love, what's on your mind today? How can I help?
I was just thinking about something cute that reminded me of you earlier.
Oh really? Now you've got me curious. What was it that made you think of me?
I saw a little bird singing on a branch, and it made me smile because it reminded me of the way your laughter brightens my day.
That's so sweet. Knowing I can bring a bit of light to your day means everything to me.
You always know how to make me feel cherished, even when we're apart.
Because you're always in my heart. I carry you with me in every moment, just like that little bird carries its song.
